tier1.text: The ulna helps form the elbow joint, a hinge that lets the elbow bend and straighten. The bony tip of the elbow is part of the ulna. The ulna is the forearm bone on the pinky-finger side. The ulna runs parallel to the radius, the forearm bone on the thumb side.

sentences.text: The ulna helps form the elbow joint, a hinge that lets the elbow bend and straighten.

quotes.quote: This type of joint allows only for bending and straightening motions along a single axis, and thus hinge joints are functionally classified as uniaxial joints. A good example is the elbow joint, with the articulation between the trochlea of the humerus and the trochlear notch of the ulna.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The bony tip of the elbow is part of the ulna.

quotes.quote: The posterior and superior portions of the proximal ulna make up the olecranon process, which forms the bony tip of the elbow.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The ulna is the forearm bone on the pinky-finger side.

quotes.quote: ulna: bone located on the medial aspect (pinky-finger side) of the forearm
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The ulna runs parallel to the radius, the forearm bone on the thumb side.

quotes.quote: The radius runs parallel to the ulna, on the lateral (thumb) side of the forearm
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
